CloudBackupSnapshot.title: CloudBackupSnapshot
CloudBackupSnapshot.description: Stores a complete backup snapshot of BDI Daily Quran & Hadis database, templates, contacts, schedule, gateway settings, and delivery logs for an authenticated admin user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the backup owner.

ownerEmail.description: Verified email address of the backup owner.

backupLabel.description: Human-readable label for the backup snapshot.

hadithCount.description: Total number of hadith/quran items stored in this snapshot.

contactCount.description: Total number of contacts stored in this snapshot.

templateCount.description: Total number of message templates stored in this snapshot.

payload.description: Structured map containing hadiths, templates, contacts, schedule, gatewaySettings, and deliveryLogs.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the backup was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the backup was updated.

/user_backups/{userId}.description: Per-user cloud backup document keyed by the user's UID.
